summary: Shell plc (UK-listed integrated oil & gas) filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine PDMR (director/manager) notification: dividend shares were acquired by executives including CEO Wael Sawan and CFO Sinead Gorman on July 2, 2026, following an interim dividend paid June 29, 2026. No special situation (acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. The filing is a standard market-abuse regime disclosure of share-based compensation for insiders, not a special-situation event.
